normalized_texts: caller: hello, is this mrs. johnson? receiver: yes, it is. who's calling? caller: my name is karen and i'm calling from customer service. how are you today? receiver: i'm fine, thanks. what's this about? caller: we've been trying to reach you because you've been selected to receive a $500 gift card from one of our major retailers. receiver: really? i didn't enter any contest or sweepstakes. caller: no, ma'am, this is a random selection. you've been chosen from a pool of our valued customers. receiver: that sounds too good to be true. what do i need to do to get it? caller: all you need to do is provide me with some information to verify your identity. receiver: what kind of information? caller: just your name, address, and credit card number to process the gift card. receiver: i'm not comfortable giving out my credit card number. caller: i completely understand, ma'am. but this is a legitimate offer and we need that information to prevent fraud. receiver: i don't think so. i'm going to hang up now. caller: wait, ma'am! if you don't take advantage of this offer, it will be gone forever!
